decisions.why: the one example, a NovyMed mobile operating chair, is ophthalmic-surgery capital equipment
the Keeler Cryomatic MKII cryo-console is capital equipment used for ophthalmic cryotherapy (e.g. retinal cryopexy)
the division is explicitly named Surgical Consumables and the example, an OVD (ophthalmic viscosurgical device), is a cataract-surgery consumable, matching the surgical consumables & packs type
a Volk portable retinal camera is ophthalmic imaging equipment

Lou's rule 25/08/2026: the division's own evidence names products from more than one category, so it goes in all of them rather than picking one — three named diagnostic/imaging devices (capital equipment & imaging) sit alongside a Braun Biolight S12 Patient Monitor, a general vital-signs monitor (non-specialist monitoring), not an ophthalmology-specific device
